473	open scoped Pointwise in
474	/-- The `k`-span of the powers of a single element `x` is closed under
475	multiplication (`xᵃ · xᵇ = xᵃ⁺ᵇ` is again a power), hence a subring — the fact
476	that makes it the target of a `Subring.closure` induction. -/
477	theorem mul_mem_span_range_pow {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
478	    (x : A) {a b : A}
479	    (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n))
480	    (hb : b ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n)) :
481	    a * b ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) := by
482	  have hSS : (Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) * (Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n)
483	      ⊆ Set.range fun n : ℕ => x ^ n := by
484	    rw [Set.mul_subset_iff]
485	    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
486	    exact ⟨p + q, by simp only [pow_add]⟩
487	  have hmul := Submodule.mul_mem_mul ha hb
488	  rw [Submodule.span_mul_span] at hmul
489	  exact Submodule.span_mono hSS hmul
490	
491	end BaseChangeSpan

499	/-- The `algebraSection` `k`-module structure on `Γ(V₀)` (registered locally so
500	the span statement uses the same module structure as `LaurentChartData.span_pow_x`
501	will at the assembly site). -/
502	noncomputable local instance instAlgebraΓV0 :
503	    Algebra k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) :=
504	  Scheme.toModuleKSheaf.algebraSection
505	    (Over.mk (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
506	    (op (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩))

508	/-- The affine-chart map `awayToSection : (ℤ[X]_{X₀})₀ → Γ(D₊(X₀))` is surjective:
509	it is the isomorphism `basicOpenIsoAway` (`X₀` is homogeneous of degree `1 > 0`). -/
510	private lemma awayToSection_X0_surjective :
511	    Function.Surjective ⇑(Proj.awayToSection
512	      (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)) := by
513	  haveI : IsIso (Proj.awayToSection
514	      (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)) := by
515	    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
516	      (X ⟨0⟩) (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩) one_pos]
517	    infer_instance
518	  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).2
519	
520	/-- **`V₀`-generators of type (1): the `Proj`-side.**  The `toProjInt`-pullback of a
521	section `s ∈ Γ(D₊(X₀))` lies in the `k`-span of the powers of `x = p1XSection`.
522	Writing `s = awayToSection a` (the affine chart iso, `awayToSection_X0_surjective`)
523	and reducing `appLE` to `app` (the chart open is `toProjInt ⁻¹ᵁ D₊(X₀)`), the pullback
524	is `ρ a` for the ring hom `ρ = appLE ∘ awayToSection`; every `a` is a `(𝒜 0)`-combination
525	of the coordinate powers (`span_p1CoordAway_pow_top`), and `ρ` carries those to the powers
526	of `x`, the `(𝒜 0) = ℤ`-scalars becoming `k`-scalars (`exists_intCast_eq_gradeZero`). -/
527	private lemma mem_span_appLE_toProjInt
528	    (s : Γ(Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)),
529	        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩))) :
530	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
531	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩))
532	        (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) (le_refl _)).hom s
533	      ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1XSection k ^ n) := by
534	  have hbridge : Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
535	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩))
536	        (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) (le_refl _)
537	      = (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).app
538	          (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)) :=
539	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
540	  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := awayToSection_X0_surjective s
541	  -- `ρ = appLE ∘ awayToSection`, with an *explicit source type* (`let` for transparency)
542	  let ρ : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
543	        (X (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))) →+*
544	      Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) :=
545	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
546	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
547	          (X (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))))
548	        (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) (le_refl _)).hom.comp
549	      (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
550	        (X (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))).hom
551	  -- `ρ (X₁/X₀) = x = p1XSection`: rewrite `appLE = app` (`hbridge`), the rest is `rfl`.
552	  have hval : ρ (p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩) = p1XSection k := by
553	    change ((Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
554	          (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
555	            (X (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))))
556	          (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) (le_refl _)).hom.comp
557	        (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
558	          (X (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))).hom)
559	        (p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩) = p1XSection k
560	    rw [hbridge]; rfl
561	  -- every away element is a `(𝒜 0)`-combination of coordinate powers (the `ℤ`-span core)
562	  have hmem : a ∈ Submodule.span (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)
563	      (Set.range fun m : ℕ => p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ ^ m) :=
564	    span_p1CoordAway_pow_top Submodule.mem_top
565	  change ρ a ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1XSection k ^ n)
566	  induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
567	  | mem z hz =>
568	      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hz
569	      rw [map_pow, hval]
570	      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩
571	  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
572	  | add u v _ _ hu hv => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu hv
573	  | smul c u _ hu =>
574	      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := exists_intCast_eq_gradeZero c
575	      rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k]
576	      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hu
577	
578	/-- **`V₀`-generators of type (2): the `Spec k`-side.**  The structure-morphism
579	pullback of a section `t ∈ Γ(Spec k, ⊤)` is the `k`-scalar `ΓSpecIso t` times `1`
580	(the structure-morphism algebra map factors as `iY.appLE ∘ ΓSpecIso.inv`), hence lies
581	in the span (which contains `1 = x⁰`). -/
582	private lemma mem_span_appLE_over
583	    (t : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens))) :
584	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
585	        ⊤ (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) le_top).hom t
586	      ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1XSection k ^ n) := by
587	  -- `kToSection = ΓSpecIso.inv ≫ iY.appLE` (morphism level, `app ⊤` shared as subterm)
588	  have hcomp : Scheme.toModuleKSheaf.kToSection
589	        (Over.mk (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
590	        (op (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩))
591	      = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
592	          Scheme.Hom.appLE
593	            (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
594	            ⊤ (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) le_top := rfl
595	  have hkTo : ∀ c : k,
596	      algebraMap k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) c
597	      = (Scheme.Hom.appLE (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
598	          ⊤ (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) le_top).hom
599	          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c) := by
600	    intro c
601	    have e1 : algebraMap k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) c
602	        = (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf.kToSection
603	            (Over.mk (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
604	            (op (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩))).hom c := rfl
605	    rw [e1, hcomp]
606	    rfl
607	  have hinv : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
608	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom t) = t :=
609	    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom_inv_id_apply t
610	  have h1 : (Scheme.Hom.appLE
611	        (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
612	        ⊤ (p1Chart k ⟨0⟩) le_top).hom t
613	      = algebraMap k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩)
614	          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom t) := by
615	    rw [hkTo, hinv]
616	  rw [h1, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
617	  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, pow_zero _⟩)
618	
619	/-- **Route step 2 (the char-free base change): `Γ(V₀) = k[x]`.**  The first chart
620	`V₀ = p1Chart ⟨0⟩ = toProjInt ⁻¹ᵁ D₊(X₀)` of the `ℙ¹` model is the pullback of the
621	affine `D₊(X₀) ⊆ Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁]` along `Spec k → ⊤_Scheme`; as a fibre product of
622	affines its section ring is the ring pushout `Γ(D₊(X₀)) ⊗_ℤ k`
623	(`isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen`), whose two structural maps ring-generate it
624	(`closure_range_union_range_eq_top_of_isPushout`).  The `Proj`-side generators land
625	in the `k`-span of the powers of `x = X₁/X₀` (`mem_span_appLE_toProjInt`); the
626	`Spec k`-side generators are `k`-multiples of `1` (`mem_span_appLE_over`).  Hence
627	`Γ(V₀)` is `k`-spanned by the powers of `x = p1XSection`. -/
628	theorem span_pow_p1XSection_scaffold :
629	    (⊤ : Submodule k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨0⟩)) ≤
630	      Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1XSection k ^ n) := by
631	  -- the defining pullback square of `ℙ¹`, in the `Scheme.Hom.pushoutSection` orientation
632	  have H : IsPullback
633	      (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
634	      (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
635	      (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
636	      (terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :=
637	    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
638	      (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))))).flip
639	  have hUY : p1Chart k ⟨0⟩
640	      = toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ⁻¹ᵁ
641	          Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)
642	        ⊓ (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := by
643	    simp only [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
644	    rfl
645	  have hUST : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) ≤
646	      terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
647	  have hUSX : Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩) ≤
648	      terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ :=
649	    le_top
650	  have hUS : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (⊤_ Scheme.{u}).Opens) := isAffineOpen_top _
651	  have hUT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) := isAffineOpen_top _
652	  have hUX : IsAffineOpen
653	      (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)) :=
654	    Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _
655	      (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩) one_pos
656	  have hIso : IsIso (pushoutSection H hUST hUSX hUY) :=
657	    isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen H hUST hUSX hUY hUS hUT hUX
658	  have hpoCat := (isIso_pushoutSection_iff H hUST hUSX hUY).mp hIso
659	  have hclos := CommRingCat.closure_range_union_range_eq_top_of_isPushout hpoCat
660	  -- ### The two generating families ring-generate `Γ(V₀)`, so every section lies in the span.
661	  intro b hbtop
662	  clear hbtop
663	  have hb : b ∈ Subring.closure _ := hclos.ge (Subring.mem_top b)
664	  induction hb using Subring.closure_induction with
665	  | mem x hx =>
666	      rcases hx with ⟨s, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, rfl⟩
667	      · exact mem_span_appLE_toProjInt k s
668	      · exact mem_span_appLE_over k t
669	  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
670	  | one => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, pow_zero _⟩
671	  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
672	  | neg x _ hx => exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hx
673	  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact mul_mem_span_range_pow _ hx hy
674	
675	/-! ### The `y`-chart mirror of the base change (`Γ(V₁) = k[y]`)
676	
677	The `X₀ ↔ X₁` mirror of `span_pow_p1XSection_scaffold`, over the second chart
678	`V₁ = p1Chart ⟨1⟩ = toProjInt ⁻¹ᵁ D₊(X₁)` with coordinate `y = X₀/X₁ = p1YSection`.
679	Every step is the swap of the corresponding `x`-chart step, transporting the `y`-chart
680	span core `span_p1CoordAwayY_pow_top`. -/
681	
682	/-- The `algebraSection` `k`-module structure on `Γ(V₁)` (mirror of `instAlgebraΓV0`). -/
683	noncomputable local instance instAlgebraΓV1 :
684	    Algebra k Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) :=
685	  Scheme.toModuleKSheaf.algebraSection
686	    (Over.mk (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
687	    (op (p1Chart k ⟨1⟩))
688	
689	/-- The affine-chart map `awayToSection : (ℤ[X]_{X₁})₀ → Γ(D₊(X₁))` is surjective
690	(`X₁` is homogeneous of degree `1 > 0`); mirror of `awayToSection_X0_surjective`. -/
691	private lemma awayToSection_X1_surjective :
692	    Function.Surjective ⇑(Proj.awayToSection
693	      (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩)) := by
694	  haveI : IsIso (Proj.awayToSection
695	      (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩)) := by
696	    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
697	      (X ⟨1⟩) (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩) one_pos]
698	    infer_instance
699	  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).2
700	
701	/-- **`V₁`-generators of type (1): the `Proj`-side (mirror).**  The `toProjInt`-pullback
702	of a section `s ∈ Γ(D₊(X₁))` lies in the `k`-span of the powers of `y = p1YSection`. -/
703	private lemma mem_span_appLE_toProjInt_y
704	    (s : Γ(Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)),
705	        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩))) :
706	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
707	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩))
708	        (p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) (le_refl _)).hom s
709	      ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1YSection k ^ n) := by
710	  have hbridge : Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
711	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩))
712	        (p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) (le_refl _)
713	      = (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).app
714	          (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨1⟩)) :=
715	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
716	  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := awayToSection_X1_surjective s
717	  let ρ : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
718	        (X (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))) →+*
719	      Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) :=
720	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
721	        (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
722	          (X (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))))
723	        (p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) (le_refl _)).hom.comp
724	      (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
725	        (X (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))).hom
726	  have hval : ρ (p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩ ⟨0⟩) = p1YSection k := by
727	    change ((Scheme.Hom.appLE (toProjInt (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
728	          (Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
729	            (X (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2))))
730	          (p1Chart k ⟨1⟩) (le_refl _)).hom.comp
731	        (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))
732	          (X (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))).hom)
733	        (p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩ ⟨0⟩) = p1YSection k
734	    rw [hbridge]; rfl
735	  have hmem : a ∈ Submodule.span (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)
736	      (Set.range fun m : ℕ => p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩ ⟨0⟩ ^ m) :=
737	    span_p1CoordAwayY_pow_top Submodule.mem_top
738	  change ρ a ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ => p1YSection k ^ n)
739	  induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
740	  | mem z hz =>
741	      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hz
742	      rw [map_pow, hval]
743	      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩
744	  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
745	  | add u v _ _ hu hv => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu hv
746	  | smul c u _ hu =>
747	      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := exists_intCast_eq_gradeZero c

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.P1ChartData
7	
8	/-!
9	# The `ℙ¹` chart ring is a polynomial ring (over an arbitrary base ring)
10	
11	For a commutative ring `R` and two *distinct* homogeneous coordinates `i ≠ j` of the
12	two-element index type `ULift (Fin 2)`, the degree-zero away ring
13	
14	`(R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀ = HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift (Fin 2)) R) (Xᵢ)`
15	
16	— the section ring of the standard affine chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` of `Proj R[X₀, X₁] = ℙ¹_R` — is a
17	*free* `R`-algebra on one generator, namely the chart coordinate `t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ`:
18	
19	`AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv : Away 𝒜 (X i) ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R`.
20	
21	This is strictly stronger than the spanning statement `Adelic.span_p1CoordAway_pow_top` of
22	`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.P1ChartData` (which only says that the powers of `Xⱼ/Xᵢ`
23	*generate* the chart ring as an `𝒜 0`-module): here the powers are also independent, so the
24	chart ring is a polynomial ring, and in particular a domain when `R` is
25	(`instIsDomainAwayP1`).  Freeness — not just spanning — is what the rigid-pushforward chart
26	computations of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforward*` need: over a rank-one free module
27	there is no room for the correction terms a merely spanning family would allow, and a
28	polynomial ring over a field is a PID, which is what makes the fibre-chart classification of
29	line bundles on `ℙ¹` available.
30	
31	## Main results
32	
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1ChartCoord` — the chart coordinate `Xⱼ/Xᵢ` over a general base;
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1Dehomogenize` — dehomogenisation `R[X₀, X₁] → R[t]`, `Xᵢ ↦ 1`;
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv` — the chart identification `Away 𝒜 (X i) ≃ₐ[R] R[t]`;
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv_p1CoordAway` — its value on the coordinate fraction
37	  `Adelic.p1CoordAway` of `P1ChartData.lean` (the integral model, `R = ULift ℤ`);
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.instIsDomainAwayP1` — the chart ring is a domain over a domain.
39	
40	## Implementation notes
41	
42	The standard grading of `R[X₀, X₁]` is *not* installed as a global instance here (Mathlib
43	deliberately leaves `MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra` unregistered, and `Picard/ProjectiveSpace.lean`
44	registers it only for the integral base `ULift ℤ`); it is taken as an instance *hypothesis*
45	`[GradedAlgebra (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift (Fin 2)) R)]`, which at `R = ULift ℤ` is discharged
46	by the project-wide instance, so the results specialise to the integral model with no
47	instance-mismatch bookkeeping.  For the same reason the grading is spelled out in full
48	throughout instead of being abbreviated by a local notation (a notation cannot carry the
49	universe annotation `ULift.{u}`).
50	
51	The `R`-algebra structure on a homogeneous localization of a graded `R`-algebra (through
52	`R → 𝒜 0 → 𝒜_(f)`) is missing from Mathlib and is supplied here in its natural namespace.
53	
54	No step of the argument uses invertibility of nonzero scalars: `R` is an arbitrary commutative
55	ring throughout (over a field this is `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1.awayAlgEquiv` of the sibling
56	project `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild`).
57	-/
58	
59	set_option autoImplicit false
60	
61	universe u
62	
63	open MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization
64	
65	namespace HomogeneousLocalization
66	
67	/-! ## The base-ring algebra structure on a homogeneous localization -/
68	
69	section BaseAlgebra
70	
71	variable {ι R A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid ι] [DecidableEq ι]
72	variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
73	variable (𝒜 : ι → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] (x : Submonoid A)
74	
75	/-- The value of the degree-zero fraction `c / 1` in the localization is the image of `c`. -/
76	lemma val_fromZeroRingHom (c : 𝒜 0) :
77	    (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c).val = algebraMap A (Localization x) (c : A) := by
78	  have h : fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c = HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, c, 1, one_mem x⟩ := rfl
79	  rw [h, val_mk, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
80	  congr 1
81	
82	/-- If `A` is a graded `R`-algebra, then any homogeneous localization of `A` is an `R`-algebra,
83	via `R → 𝒜 0 → HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x`.  The scalar action is the existing pointwise
84	one. -/
85	noncomputable instance instAlgebraBase : Algebra R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) where
86	  toSMul := inferInstanceAs (SMul R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x))
87	  algebraMap := (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0))
88	  commutes' _ _ := mul_comm _ _
89	  smul_def' r z := by
90	    apply val_injective
91	    change (r • z).val = ((fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0)) r * z).val
92	    rw [val_mul, val_smul x r z, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom,
93	      SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap]
94	    induction z.val using Localization.induction_on with
95	    | H w =>
96	      rw [Localization.smul_mk, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul,
97	        Algebra.smul_def]
98	      exact congrArg (Localization.mk _) (Subtype.ext (one_mul _).symm)
99	
100	/-- The structure map of `HomogeneousLocalization.instAlgebraBase` factors through `𝒜 0`. -/
101	lemma algebraMap_eq_comp :
102	    algebraMap R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) =
103	      (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0)) :=
104	  rfl
105	
106	instance : IsScalarTower R (𝒜 0) (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) :=
107	  .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
108	
109	@[simp]
110	lemma algebraMap_val (r : R) :
111	    (algebraMap R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) r).val =
112	      algebraMap A (Localization x) (algebraMap R A r) := by
113	  rw [algebraMap_eq_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom,
114	    SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap]
115	
116	end BaseAlgebra
117	
118	end HomogeneousLocalization

120	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic
121	
122	/-! ## The chart ring of `ℙ¹` over a general commutative ring -/
123	
124	section ChartRing
125	
126	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
127	
128	/-! ### Generalities on the two-element index type -/
129	
130	/-- Two distinct homogeneous coordinates exhaust the index type. -/
131	private theorem univ_eq_pair {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
132	    (Finset.univ : Finset (ULift.{u} (Fin 2))) = {i, j} :=
133	  (Finset.eq_univ_of_card _ (by rw [Finset.card_pair hij]; simp)).symm
134	
135	/-- Reading the total degree off a `Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top` exponent vector. -/
136	private theorem add_eq_of_sum_smul_one {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j)
137	    {e : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℕ} {a : ℕ} (hae : ∑ l, e l • (1 : ℕ) = a • (1 : ℕ)) :
138	    e i + e j = a := by
139	  rw [univ_eq_pair hij, Finset.sum_pair hij] at hae
140	  simpa using hae
141	
142	/-- The two-element index type has, for each `i`, an index distinct from `i`. -/
143	private theorem exists_ne_index (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) : ∃ j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2), i ≠ j :=
144	  ⟨⟨i.down + 1⟩, fun h => by simpa using congrArg (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) => l.down) h⟩
145	
146	/-- A product over the two homogeneous coordinates, in the order given by `i ≠ j`. -/
147	private theorem prod_X_pow_eq {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j)
148	    (e : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℕ) :
149	    (∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) ^ e l) = X i ^ e i * X j ^ e j := by
150	  rw [univ_eq_pair hij, Finset.prod_pair hij]
151	
152	/-- The variable `Xᵢ` of `R[X₀, X₁]` is homogeneous of degree one. -/
153	theorem p1X_mem_deg_one (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
154	    (X i : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R 1 :=
155	  isHomogeneous_X _ _
156	
157	/-! ### Dehomogenisation -/
158	
159	/-- Dehomogenisation at `Xᵢ`: the `R`-algebra map `R[X₀, X₁] → R[t]` with `Xᵢ ↦ 1`,
160	`Xⱼ ↦ t`. -/
161	noncomputable def p1Dehomogenize (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
162	    MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R →ₐ[R] Polynomial R :=
163	  MvPolynomial.aeval (Function.update (fun _ => Polynomial.X) i 1)
164	
165	@[simp]
166	theorem p1Dehomogenize_X_self (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) : p1Dehomogenize R i (X i) = 1 := by
167	  rw [p1Dehomogenize, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Function.update_self]
168	
169	theorem p1Dehomogenize_X_of_ne {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
170	    p1Dehomogenize R i (X j) = Polynomial.X := by
171	  rw [p1Dehomogenize, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Function.update_of_ne hij.symm]
172	
173	private theorem isUnit_p1Dehomogenize_X_self (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
174	    IsUnit ((p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom (X i)) := by
175	  have h : (p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom (X i) = 1 := p1Dehomogenize_X_self R i
176	  rw [h]
177	  exact isUnit_one
178	
179	/-! ### The degree-zero part -/
180	
181	/-- The degree-zero part of `R[X₀, X₁]` consists of the constants: every element of `𝒜 0` is
182	the image of a scalar.  (Over a field this is the bijectivity half of

258	  commutes' r := by

261	        ((algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i)) r).val)

274	    rw [mul_one]
275	    exact p1Dehomogenize_X_self R i
276	  have h := Localization.awayLift_mk (A := Polynomial R)
277	    ((p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom) (X i) a 1 h1 n

297	private theorem away_mk_prod_eq {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ)
298	    (e : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℕ) (hae : e i + e j = a)
299	    (H : (∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) ^ e l) ∈
300	      homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R (a • 1)) :
301	    Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) a
302	        (∏ l, X l ^ e l) H
303	      = p1ChartCoord R i j ^ e j := by
304	  rw [p1ChartCoord_pow, ext_iff_val, Away.val_mk, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
305	    Localization.r_iff_exists]
306	  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
307	  push_cast
308	  rw [prod_X_pow_eq R hij e, ← hae]
309	  ring

311	theorem p1PolyToAway_surjective {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
312	    Function.Surjective (p1PolyToAway R i j) := by
313	  intro z
314	  have hz : z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R 0)
315	      (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i))) := trivial
316	  rw [← Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) X (adjoin_gradeZero_range_X R)
317	    (fun _ => 1) (fun l => p1X_mem_deg_one R l)] at hz
318	  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
319	  | mem w hw =>
320	    obtain ⟨a, e, hae, rfl⟩ := hw
321	    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ e j, ?_⟩
322	    rw [map_pow, p1PolyToAway_X]
323	    exact (away_mk_prod_eq R hij a e (add_eq_of_sum_smul_one hij hae) _).symm
324	  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
325	  | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
326	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hu
327	    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hv
328	    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
329	  | smul c w _ hw =>
330	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hw
331	    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_gradeZero R c
332	    exact ⟨r • p, by rw [map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]⟩

339	  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, p1AwayToPoly_p1PolyToAway_apply R hij]

343	/-- **The chart ring of `ℙ¹` is free.**  The section ring `(R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀` of the standard
344	chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` of `ℙ¹_R` is a polynomial ring over `R`, on the chart coordinate
345	`t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ` (`p1ChartCoord`). -/

347	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i) ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R :=
348	  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (p1AwayToPoly R i) (p1PolyToAway R i j)

/-!
## Sections of fibered products

Suppose we are given the following cartesian square:
```
Y --g-→ X
|       |
iY      iX
↓       |
T --f-→ S
```
Let `Uₛ` be an open of `S`, `Uₓ` and `Uₜ` be opens of `X` and `T` mapping into `Uₛ`.
There is a canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, pr₁ ⁻¹ Uₓ ∩ pr₂ ⁻¹ Uₜ)`.

We show that this map is
1. `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen`:
  bijective when `Uₛ`, `Uₜ`, and `Uₓ` are all affine.
2. `mono_pushoutSection_of_isCompact_of_flat_right`:
  injective when `Uₛ`, `Uₜ` are affine, `Uₓ` is compact, and `f` is flat.
3. `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right`:
  bijective when `Uₛ`, `Uₜ` are affine, `Uₓ` is qcqs, and `f` is flat.
4. `mono_pushoutSection_of_isCompact_of_flat_right_of_ringHomFlat`:
  injective when `Uₛ` is affine, `Uₜ` is compact, `Uₓ` is qcqs, `f` is flat,
  and `Γ(T, Uₜ)` is flat over `Γ(S, Uₛ)` (typically true when `S = Spec k`.)
5. `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isCompact_of_flat_right_of_ringHomFlat`:
  bijective when `Uₛ` is affine, `Uₜ` and `Uₓ` are qcqs, `f` is flat,
  and `Γ(T, Uₜ)` is flat over `Γ(S, Uₛ)` (typically true when `S = Spec k`.)

-/

variable {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}} {f : T ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ X} {iX : X ⟶ S} {iY : Y ⟶ T}
  (H : IsPullback g iY iX f)
  {US : S.Opens} {UT : T.Opens}
  {UX : X.Opens} (hUST : UT ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ US) (hUSX : UX ≤ iX ⁻¹ᵁ US)
  {UY : Y.Opens} (hUY : UY = g ⁻¹ᵁ UX ⊓ iY ⁻¹ᵁ UT)

/-- The canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, pr₁ ⁻¹ Uₓ ∩ pr₂ ⁻¹ Uₜ)`.
This is an isomorphism under various circumstances. -/
abbrev pushoutSection : pushout (iX.appLE US UX hUSX) (f.appLE US UT hUST) ⟶ Γ(Y, UY) :=
  pushout.desc (g.appLE UX UY (by simp [*])) (iY.appLE UT UY (by simp [*]))
    (by simp only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, H.w])

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
lemma isIso_pushoutSection_iff :
    IsIso (pushoutSection H hUST hUSX hUY) ↔ IsPushout (iX.appLE US UX hUSX) (f.appLE US UT hUST)
      (g.appLE UX UY (by simp [*])) (iY.appLE UT UY (by simp [*])) :=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ .of_iso (.of_hasPushout _ _) (.refl _) (.refl _) (.refl _)
    (asIso (pushoutSection H hUST hUSX hUY)) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp),
    fun h ↦ inferInstanceAs (IsIso h.isoPushout.inv)⟩

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
attribute [local simp] IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom in
attribute [local simp← ] Scheme.Hom.resLE_eq_morphismRestrict in
lemma isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (hUS : IsAffineOpen US) (hUT : IsAffineOpen UT)
    (hUX : IsAffineOpen UX) : IsIso (pushoutSection H hUST hUSX hUY) := by
  refine (isIso_pushoutSection_iff ..).mpr (IsPullback.of_map_of_faithful Scheme.Spec ?_).unop

  have : IsAffine _ := hUT
  have : IsAffine _ := hUX

    .of_isIso (Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE H hUST hUSX hUY).isoPullback.hom
  exact .of_iso (Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE H hUST hUSX hUY).flip hUY'.isoSpec hUT.isoSpec
    hUX.isoSpec hUS.isoSpec (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)

8	/-!
9	# The `ℙ¹` chart ring is a polynomial ring (over an arbitrary base ring)
10	
11	For a commutative ring `R` and two *distinct* homogeneous coordinates `i ≠ j` of the
12	two-element index type `ULift (Fin 2)`, the degree-zero away ring
13	
14	`(R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀ = HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift (Fin 2)) R) (Xᵢ)`
15	
16	— the section ring of the standard affine chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` of `Proj R[X₀, X₁] = ℙ¹_R` — is a
17	*free* `R`-algebra on one generator, namely the chart coordinate `t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ`:
18	
19	`AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv : Away 𝒜 (X i) ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R`.
20	
21	This is strictly stronger than the spanning statement `Adelic.span_p1CoordAway_pow_top` of
22	`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.P1ChartData` (which only says that the powers of `Xⱼ/Xᵢ`
23	*generate* the chart ring as an `𝒜 0`-module): here the powers are also independent, so the
24	chart ring is a polynomial ring, and in particular a domain when `R` is
25	(`instIsDomainAwayP1`).  Freeness — not just spanning — is what the rigid-pushforward chart
26	computations of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforward*` need: over a rank-one free module
27	there is no room for the correction terms a merely spanning family would allow, and a
28	polynomial ring over a field is a PID, which is what makes the fibre-chart classification of
29	line bundles on `ℙ¹` available.
30	
31	## Main results
32	
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1ChartCoord` — the chart coordinate `Xⱼ/Xᵢ` over a general base;
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1Dehomogenize` — dehomogenisation `R[X₀, X₁] → R[t]`, `Xᵢ ↦ 1`;
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv` — the chart identification `Away 𝒜 (X i) ≃ₐ[R] R[t]`;
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1AwayAlgEquiv_p1CoordAway` — its value on the coordinate fraction
37	  `Adelic.p1CoordAway` of `P1ChartData.lean` (the integral model, `R = ULift ℤ`);
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.instIsDomainAwayP1` — the chart ring is a domain over a domain.
39	
40	## Implementation notes
41	
42	The standard grading of `R[X₀, X₁]` is *not* installed as a global instance here (Mathlib
43	deliberately leaves `MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra` unregistered, and `Picard/ProjectiveSpace.lean`
44	registers it only for the integral base `ULift ℤ`); it is taken as an instance *hypothesis*
45	`[GradedAlgebra (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift (Fin 2)) R)]`, which at `R = ULift ℤ` is discharged
46	by the project-wide instance, so the results specialise to the integral model with no
47	instance-mismatch bookkeeping.  For the same reason the grading is spelled out in full
48	throughout instead of being abbreviated by a local notation (a notation cannot carry the
49	universe annotation `ULift.{u}`).
50	
51	The `R`-algebra structure on a homogeneous localization of a graded `R`-algebra (through
52	`R → 𝒜 0 → 𝒜_(f)`) is missing from Mathlib and is supplied here in its natural namespace.
53	
54	No step of the argument uses invertibility of nonzero scalars: `R` is an arbitrary commutative
55	ring throughout (over a field this is `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1.awayAlgEquiv` of the sibling
56	project `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild`).
57	-/

71	variable {ι R A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid ι] [DecidableEq ι]
72	variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
73	variable (𝒜 : ι → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] (x : Submonoid A)
74	
75	/-- The value of the degree-zero fraction `c / 1` in the localization is the image of `c`. -/
76	lemma val_fromZeroRingHom (c : 𝒜 0) :
77	    (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c).val = algebraMap A (Localization x) (c : A) := by
78	  have h : fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c = HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, c, 1, one_mem x⟩ := rfl
79	  rw [h, val_mk, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
80	  congr 1
81	
82	/-- If `A` is a graded `R`-algebra, then any homogeneous localization of `A` is an `R`-algebra,
83	via `R → 𝒜 0 → HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x`.  The scalar action is the existing pointwise
84	one. -/
85	noncomputable instance instAlgebraBase : Algebra R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) where
86	  toSMul := inferInstanceAs (SMul R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x))
87	  algebraMap := (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0))
88	  commutes' _ _ := mul_comm _ _
89	  smul_def' r z := by
90	    apply val_injective
91	    change (r • z).val = ((fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0)) r * z).val
92	    rw [val_mul, val_smul x r z, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom,
93	      SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap]
94	    induction z.val using Localization.induction_on with
95	    | H w =>
96	      rw [Localization.smul_mk, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul,
97	        Algebra.smul_def]
98	      exact congrArg (Localization.mk _) (Subtype.ext (one_mul _).symm)
99

101	lemma algebraMap_eq_comp :
102	    algebraMap R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) =
103	      (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x).comp (algebraMap R (𝒜 0)) :=
104	  rfl

106	instance : IsScalarTower R (𝒜 0) (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) :=
107	  .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl

112	      algebraMap A (Localization x) (algebraMap R A r) := by
113	  rw [algebraMap_eq_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom,

207	    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _

216	/-! ### The chart coordinate -/
217	
218	/-- The chart coordinate `t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ` in the section ring of the chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` of `ℙ¹_R`.
219	At `R = ULift ℤ` this is `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1CoordAway`. -/
220	noncomputable def p1ChartCoord (i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
221	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i) :=
222	  Away.mk _ (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) 1 (X j) (by simpa using p1X_mem_deg_one R j)
223	
224	theorem val_p1ChartCoord (i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
225	    (p1ChartCoord R i j).val = Localization.mk (X j)
226	      (⟨X i ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X i : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R)) :=
227	  rfl
228	
229	theorem p1ChartCoord_pow (i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (m : ℕ) :
230	    p1ChartCoord R i j ^ m =
231	      Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) m (X j ^ m)
232	        (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded m (p1X_mem_deg_one R j)) := by
233	  rw [ext_iff_val, val_pow, val_p1ChartCoord, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_pow,
234	    Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
235	  exact ⟨1, by push_cast; ring⟩

237	/-! ### The two `R`-algebra maps between the chart ring and the polynomial ring -/
238	
239	/-- `R[t] → (R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀`, `t ↦ Xⱼ/Xᵢ`.  Bijective for `i ≠ j`; see `p1AwayAlgEquiv`. -/
240	noncomputable def p1PolyToAway (i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
241	    Polynomial R →ₐ[R] Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i) :=
242	  Polynomial.aeval (p1ChartCoord R i j)
243	
244	@[simp]
245	theorem p1PolyToAway_X (i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
246	    p1PolyToAway R i j Polynomial.X = p1ChartCoord R i j :=
247	  Polynomial.aeval_X _
248	
249	/-- `(R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀ → R[t]`, induced by dehomogenisation at `Xᵢ`.  Inverse of
250	`p1PolyToAway`; see `p1AwayAlgEquiv`. -/
251	noncomputable def p1AwayToPoly (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
252	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i) →ₐ[R] Polynomial R where
253	  toRingHom :=
254	    (Localization.awayLift (p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom (X i)
255	      (isUnit_p1Dehomogenize_X_self R i)).comp
256	      (algebraMap (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i))
257	        (Localization.Away (X i : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R)))
258	  commutes' r := by
259	    change (Localization.awayLift (p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom (X i)
260	        (isUnit_p1Dehomogenize_X_self R i))
261	        ((algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i)) r).val)
262	      = algebraMap R (Polynomial R) r
263	    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_val, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
264	    exact (p1Dehomogenize R i).commutes r
265	
266	/-- The workhorse: `p1AwayToPoly` sends `a/Xᵢⁿ` to the dehomogenisation of `a`. -/
267	theorem p1AwayToPoly_mk (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (n : ℕ)
268	    (a : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R)
269	    (ha : a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R (n • 1)) :
270	    p1AwayToPoly R i
271	        (Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) n a ha)
272	      = p1Dehomogenize R i a := by
273	  have h1 : (p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom (X i) * 1 = 1 := by
274	    rw [mul_one]
275	    exact p1Dehomogenize_X_self R i
276	  have h := Localization.awayLift_mk (A := Polynomial R)
277	    ((p1Dehomogenize R i).toRingHom) (X i) a 1 h1 n
278	  exact h.trans (by rw [one_pow, mul_one]; rfl)
279	
280	@[simp]
281	theorem p1AwayToPoly_p1ChartCoord {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
282	    p1AwayToPoly R i (p1ChartCoord R i j) = Polynomial.X :=
283	  (p1AwayToPoly_mk R i 1 (X j) (by simpa using p1X_mem_deg_one R j)).trans
284	    (p1Dehomogenize_X_of_ne R hij)
285	
286	theorem p1AwayToPoly_comp_p1PolyToAway {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
287	    (p1AwayToPoly R i).comp (p1PolyToAway R i j) = AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R) := by
288	  apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
289	  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, p1PolyToAway_X, p1AwayToPoly_p1ChartCoord R hij, AlgHom.id_apply]
290	
291	theorem p1AwayToPoly_p1PolyToAway_apply {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j)
292	    (p : Polynomial R) : p1AwayToPoly R i (p1PolyToAway R i j p) = p :=
293	  AlgHom.congr_fun (p1AwayToPoly_comp_p1PolyToAway R hij) p
294	
295	/-! ### Surjectivity of `p1PolyToAway` -/
296	
297	private theorem away_mk_prod_eq {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ)
298	    (e : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℕ) (hae : e i + e j = a)
299	    (H : (∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) ^ e l) ∈
300	      homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R (a • 1)) :
301	    Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) a
302	        (∏ l, X l ^ e l) H
303	      = p1ChartCoord R i j ^ e j := by
304	  rw [p1ChartCoord_pow, ext_iff_val, Away.val_mk, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
305	    Localization.r_iff_exists]
306	  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
307	  push_cast
308	  rw [prod_X_pow_eq R hij e, ← hae]
309	  ring
310	
311	theorem p1PolyToAway_surjective {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
312	    Function.Surjective (p1PolyToAway R i j) := by
313	  intro z
314	  have hz : z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R 0)
315	      (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i))) := trivial
316	  rw [← Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top (p1X_mem_deg_one R i) X (adjoin_gradeZero_range_X R)
317	    (fun _ => 1) (fun l => p1X_mem_deg_one R l)] at hz
318	  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
319	  | mem w hw =>
320	    obtain ⟨a, e, hae, rfl⟩ := hw
321	    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ e j, ?_⟩
322	    rw [map_pow, p1PolyToAway_X]
323	    exact (away_mk_prod_eq R hij a e (add_eq_of_sum_smul_one hij hae) _).symm
324	  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
325	  | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
326	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hu
327	    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hv
328	    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
329	  | smul c w _ hw =>
330	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hw
331	    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_gradeZero R c
332	    exact ⟨r • p, by rw [map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]⟩
333	
334	theorem p1PolyToAway_comp_p1AwayToPoly {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
335	    (p1PolyToAway R i j).comp (p1AwayToPoly R i)
336	      = AlgHom.id R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i)) := by
337	  refine AlgHom.ext fun z => ?_
338	  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := p1PolyToAway_surjective R hij z
339	  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, p1AwayToPoly_p1PolyToAway_apply R hij]

341	/-! ### The chart identification -/
342	
343	/-- **The chart ring of `ℙ¹` is free.**  The section ring `(R[X₀, X₁]_{Xᵢ})₀` of the standard
344	chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` of `ℙ¹_R` is a polynomial ring over `R`, on the chart coordinate
345	`t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ` (`p1ChartCoord`). -/
346	noncomputable def p1AwayAlgEquiv {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
347	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i) ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R :=
348	  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (p1AwayToPoly R i) (p1PolyToAway R i j)
349	    (p1AwayToPoly_comp_p1PolyToAway R hij) (p1PolyToAway_comp_p1AwayToPoly R hij)
350	
351	@[simp]
352	theorem p1AwayAlgEquiv_p1ChartCoord {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
353	    p1AwayAlgEquiv R hij (p1ChartCoord R i j) = Polynomial.X :=
354	  p1AwayToPoly_p1ChartCoord R hij
355	
356	@[simp]
357	theorem p1AwayAlgEquiv_symm_X {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
358	    (p1AwayAlgEquiv R hij).symm Polynomial.X = p1ChartCoord R i j :=
359	  (p1AwayAlgEquiv R hij).symm_apply_eq.mpr (p1AwayAlgEquiv_p1ChartCoord R hij).symm
360	
361	theorem p1AwayAlgEquiv_p1PolyToAway {i j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)} (hij : i ≠ j) (p : Polynomial R) :
362	    p1AwayAlgEquiv R hij (p1PolyToAway R i j p) = p :=
363	  p1AwayToPoly_p1PolyToAway_apply R hij p

365	/-- **The chart ring of `ℙ¹` over a domain is a domain**, being a polynomial ring. -/
366	instance instIsDomainAwayP1 [IsDomain R] (i : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
367	    IsDomain (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) R) (X i)) := by

369	  exact Function.Injective.isDomain (p1AwayAlgEquiv R hij).toRingEquiv.toRingHom

169	`X₀^a X₁^b / X₀^(a+b)` equals `(X₁/X₀)^b`. -/

173	/-- The pure monomial identity `(x₀¹)ᵇ (x₀ᵃ x₁ᵇ) = x₀^(a+b) x₁ᵇ`, proved in a generic
174	commutative monoid so the certificate never touches the expensive `MvPolynomial`
175	`ring` normalisation. -/
176	private lemma pow_mul_pow_identity {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] (x0 x1 : A) (a b : ℕ) :
177	    (x0 ^ 1) ^ b * (x0 ^ a * x1 ^ b) = x0 ^ (a + b) * x1 ^ b := by
178	  rw [pow_one, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm b a]
179	
180	/-- The degree-`(a+b)` monomial fraction `X₀^a X₁^b / X₀^(a+b)` as an element of the
181	degree-zero away ring `(ℤ[X]_{X₀})₀`.  (Isolating the `Away.mk` inside a definition,
182	with the homogeneity obligation discharged by a `by`-block rather than a pre-typed
183	term, keeps the concrete graded-instance `isDefEq` from blowing up — cf. `p1CoordAway`.) -/
184	noncomputable def p1Monomial (a b : ℕ) :
185	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩) :=
186	  Away.mk _ (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩) (a + b)
187	    (X ⟨0⟩ ^ a * X ⟨1⟩ ^ b)
188	    (by
189	      rw [add_smul]
190	      exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded
191	        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded a (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩))
192	        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded b (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩)))

196	coordinate fraction.  This is the per-monomial step of the chart-ring spanning
197	`Γ(V₀) = k[X₁/X₀]`. -/
198	lemma p1Monomial_eq_coordPow (a b : ℕ) :
199	    p1Monomial a b = p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ ^ b := by
200	  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
201	  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow]
202	  simp only [p1Monomial, p1CoordAway, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_pow]
203	  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
204	  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
205	  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow]
206	  exact pow_mul_pow_identity _ _ a b
207	
208	/-- Two-variable monomial expansion: the monomial `X^d · c` in `ℤ[X₀, X₁]` is
209	`c · X₀^{d₀} · X₁^{d₁}` (`Finsupp.prod` over the two-element index reduced with
210	`Fin.prod_univ_two` through the `ULift (Fin 2) ≃ Fin 2` equivalence). -/

/-!
# (Co)Limits of Schemes

We construct various limits and colimits in the category of schemes.

* The existence of fibred products was shown in `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Pullbacks.lean`.
* `Spec ℤ` is the terminal object.
* The preceding two results imply that `Scheme` has all finite limits.
* The empty scheme is the (strict) initial object.
* The disjoint union is the coproduct of a family of schemes, and the forgetful functor to
  `LocallyRingedSpace` and `TopCat` preserves them.

## TODO

* Spec preserves finite coproducts.

-/

/-- `Spec ℤ` is the terminal object in the category of schemes. -/
noncomputable def specZIsTerminal : IsTerminal (Spec <| .of ℤ) :=
  @IsTerminal.isTerminalObj _ _ _ _ Scheme.Spec _ inferInstance
    (terminalOpOfInitial CommRingCat.zIsInitial)

/-- `Spec ℤ` is the terminal object in the category of schemes. -/
noncomputable def specULiftZIsTerminal : IsTerminal (Spec <| .of <| ULift.{u} ℤ) :=
  @IsTerminal.isTerminalObj _ _ _ _ Scheme.Spec _ inferInstance
    (terminalOpOfInitial CommRingCat.isInitial)

instance : HasTerminal Scheme :=
  hasTerminal_of_hasTerminal_of_preservesLimit Scheme.Spec

instance : IsAffine (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) :=
  .of_isIso (PreservesTerminal.iso Scheme.Spec).inv

instance : HasFiniteLimits Scheme :=
  hasFiniteLimits_of_hasTerminal_and_pullbacks

instance (X : Scheme.{u}) : X.Over (⊤_ _) := ⟨terminal.from _⟩
instance {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (⊤_ Scheme)] [Y.Over (⊤_ Scheme)] (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    @Scheme.Hom.IsOver _ _ f (⊤_ Scheme) ‹_› ‹_› := ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

instance {X : Scheme} : Subsingleton (X.Over (⊤_ Scheme)) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨a⟩ ⟨b⟩ ↦ by simp [Subsingleton.elim a b]⟩

section Initial

/-- The map from the empty scheme. -/
@[simps]
def Scheme.emptyTo (X : Scheme.{u}) : ∅ ⟶ X :=
  ⟨{  base := TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => PEmpty.elim x, by fun_prop⟩
      c := { app := fun _ => CommRingCat.punitIsTerminal.from _ } }, fun x => PEmpty.elim x⟩

@[ext]
theorem Scheme.empty_ext {X : Scheme.{u}} (f g : ∅ ⟶ X) : f = g :=
  Scheme.Hom.ext' (Subsingleton.elim (α := ∅ ⟶ _) _ _)

theorem Scheme.eq_emptyTo {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : ∅ ⟶ X) : f = Scheme.emptyTo X :=
  Scheme.empty_ext f (Scheme.emptyTo X)

instance Scheme.hom_unique_of_empty_source (X : Scheme.{u}) : Unique (∅ ⟶ X) :=
  ⟨⟨Scheme.emptyTo _⟩, fun _ => Scheme.empty_ext _ _⟩

/-- The empty scheme is the initial object in the category of schemes. -/
def emptyIsInitial : IsInitial (∅ : Scheme.{u}) :=
  IsInitial.ofUnique _

@[simp]
theorem emptyIsInitial_to : emptyIsInitial.to = Scheme.emptyTo :=
  rfl

instance : IsEmpty (∅ : Scheme.{u}) :=
  show IsEmpty PEmpty by infer_instance

  haveI : IsEmpty X := f.base.hom.1.isEmpty
